text:
ada: Heads-up: FinCap just reported recurring 503s on their Dedicated pool for model redwood-large (tail p99 spikes). CS escalated, asked for a short-term workaround + owner commitments. Can @sahil take lead on triage? We need a patch window tonight 22:00 UTC max.
omar: I'm oncall this evening, can help with mitigation. Quick question — are errors from inference nodes or load balancer? CS provided logs showing `503 upstream reset` from kube-proxy for pool-dedicated-42.
sahil: I'll take ownership. Initial plan: 1) quick canary revert to previous model variant (v1.3-quant) 2) apply connection limit bump on nginx LB 3) long-term: investigate KV cache leak that might be causing high mem churn. Need PR approvals for the revert, can someone do CR? @rebecca can you review?
rebecca: on it. I can do a lightweight CR around 20:30 UTC. Ping me the PR.
nada: CS says customer is on a strict SLA; they want ETA within 4 hours. Can we commit to a rollout by 22:00 UTC and rollback if errors persist?
sahil: Yes commit to attempted canary at 21:30 UTC, full rollout by 22:00 if green. If errors persist we'll rollback to v1.2-quant and open a P1. I'll be primary owner during the window. Assigning tasks:
- sahil: lead rollout + post-commit checks
- omar: LB config bump + metrics watch
- rebecca: CR + quick approval
- ada: CS point + customer comms

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started by sahil for fincap/pool-dedicated-42 -> image redwood-large:v1.3-quant @ 21:30 UTC
omar: LB bump applied: `kubectl patch svc lb-dedicated-42 -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Local"}}'` — monitor for 5m.
nada: FYI logs from CS show spikes at 21:18 then 21:24; attaching snippet:
```
21:18:14 ERROR inference: request failed status=503 upstream_reset srv=pool-dedicated-42 node=ded-node-7
21:24:05 WARN kernel: kv_cache_miss rate=0.9
```
sahil: saw the same in traces. Post-canary checks: p99 latency, 5xx rate, KV cache evictions. Will post results in 15m.
rebecca: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821 — changed model tag fallback logic. Added canned test. Leaving comments now.
nada: Customer comms: "we have a planned mitigation tonight at 22:00 UTC; we'll confirm success or rollback within 30m."
sahil: Canary looks ok at +7m: 5xx down to 0.2% from 2.3%, p99 from 2.1s to 1.6s. Proceeding to full rollout.
deploy-bot: Full rollout initiated by sahil -> redwood-large:v1.3-quant to 100% @ 21:45 UTC
omar: Post-rollout metric snapshot: 5xx 0.3%, p99 1.7s, mem usage stable. Keeping watch for 30m.
nada: Great. Filing follow-up ticket for root cause: JIRA FINCAP-789. Owner: sahil. ETA for RCA: EOD tomorrow. Will schedule deep-dive with eng-ml next day to look at KV cache behavior.
rebecca: CR merged. Small follow-up fix queued (non-blocking) — will open PR tomorrow.
sahil: Thanks team. If anything regresses, I'll re-initiate rollback and tag eng-sre.
customer-success-bot: Customer notified: "Mitigation applied; monitoring for 30 minutes. We'll update you within 30 minutes or earlier."
nada: Closing the thread — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
